raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: BIS has rescinded the Biden-era firearms export rule, easing licensing and classification treatment for civilian firearms and ammunition under the Export Administration Regulations. Exporters of civilian firearms (HS 9302, 9303.20, 9303.30) should re-verify ECCN classification and license requirements, update internal compliance programs, and confirm that no items remain controlled for national security or foreign policy reasons. Section 301 tariff exposure and HTS alignment still apply to physical shipments, and restricted party / Entity List screening remains mandatory for all destinations.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，放宽了民用枪支及弹药在《出口管理条例》下的许可与分类处理。民用枪支（HS 9302、9303.20、9303.30）出口商应重新核实ECCN分类和许可要求，更新内部合规计划，并确认相关物项不再因国家安全或外交政策原因受控。实体货物仍需关注301关税风险及HTS归类一致性，且对所有目的地仍须进行受限方/实体清单筛查。

checklist.desc: Re-classify civilian firearms and ammunition under the rescinded rule; confirm whether items moved from license-required to NLR or other ECCNs and document the basis.
Screen all buyers, consignees, and end users against the BIS Entity List, SDN list, and denied persons lists; retain screening records.
Map the 10-digit HTS line for each firearm/ammunition item, check Section 301 list exposure, and document country of origin and value build-up.
Obtain and retain end-user and end-use certificates confirming civilian use and non-re-export to restricted destinations.
Revise the internal compliance program, retrain staff on the rescinded rule, and archive prior licenses and classification determinations.
Confirm ammunition and component shipments meet applicable US environmental and hazardous materials transport requirements where relevant.
